# References

- [doi:10.1093/comjnl/7.4.308](https://doi.org/10.1093/comjnl/7.4.308): the simplex search mzLib maximizes the link's likelihood with (Nelder and Mead, Comput J 7:308, 1965)
- [doi:10.1093/biomet/81.3.624](https://doi.org/10.1093/biomet/81.3.624): adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature, which integrates each cell's probability over its latent normal (Liu and Pierce, Biometrika 81:624, 1994)
- [doi:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1948.tb00014.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.2517-6161.1948.tb00014.x): the beta-binomial distribution, the count model with overdispersion (Skellam, J R Stat Soc B 10:257, 1948)
